description.it: I Detti di frate Egidio d’Assisi, diciotto capitoli di massime sui vizi e le virtù: la fede, l’umiltà, la pazienza, la carità, la preghiera, la contemplazione.
description.en-US: The Sayings of Brother Giles of Assisi: eighteen chapters of maxims on vices and virtues, faith, humility, patience, charity, prayer and contemplation. Italian.
description.pt-BR: Os Ditos de frei Egídio de Assis: dezoito capítulos de máximas sobre os vícios e as virtudes.

it.editor: transcription by M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari; edition not stated

sources.edition: Detti di frate Egidio, poliba.it (Wayback Machine snapshot).
sources.description: Eighteen chapters. The English of the CCEL Hudleston revision (Part IV) is not imported.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval text. The transcription (M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari, Biblioteca di Scienze del Cristianesimo, 2000-02) survives only in the Wayback Machine; it states no edition, but its biblical apparatus follows Fontes Franciscani (1995). Free in practice, edition unverified.
